records.note: No prison-housing placement data for trans prisoners in Nicaragua was found. The mandated enwiki full-text search surfaced only 'LGBTQ rights in Nicaragua' as a country-specific hit; that page (fetched, HTTP 200) covers criminal-penalty history (2008 repeal of the sodomy law; Penal Code Article 315 discrimination offense) but contains no placement rule (birth-sex vs identity), no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice or documented trans-prisoner case. The US State Dept 2023 country report on Nicaragua was only retrievable as a 'Technical Difficulties' error page in this run, so its prison/LGBTI sections could not be re-verified within the fetch budget; no usable finding.
